about: Limits and word lists for discovery-ranking-algorithm-fixer. scripts/algorithm_fix_plan.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; SKILL.md and references/change-format.md say how the plan's checks block or warn.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: At most this many ready creates and renames go into one batch, with one yes; more go into further batches. Each live weight change and each delete is always a batch of its own and doesn't count here.
notes.weight_min: The lowest weight a signal may have, given or after rebalancing and rounding: blocker below it. Ranking Studio's top-level (combined) weights are shares of weight_total.
notes.weight_max: The highest weight a signal may have, given or after rebalancing and rounding: blocker above it.
notes.weight_total: The top-level weights must add up to this: create_ranking_algorithm documents MANUAL weights summing to 100, and saved algorithms add up to it (trained ones to within rounding).
notes.weight_sum_tolerance: How far the new weights may add up from weight_total before the change is blocked (trained weights are unrounded, so they rarely add up to exactly 100).
notes.weight_decimals: Every weight sent is rounded to this many decimal places, and the rounding remainder goes on the biggest weight so the total is exactly weight_total (MANUAL algorithms need it exact). Signals moved only by rounding are listed in the plan's signals.
notes.high_traffic_visits: An algorithm that is the Default, or whose sampled pages had at least this many visits in the review, is high-traffic: changing its weights in place is blocked unless the user chooses to skip the A/B test (skip_test); the plan suggests a corrected copy and discovery-experiment-setup instead.
notes.max_custom_per_catalog: create_abr_algorithm documents at most this many custom algorithms per catalog. The plan counts custom_types per catalog and page type, and blocks a copy at the limit.
notes.custom_types: Algorithm types that count as custom for max_custom_per_catalog.
notes.protected_types: Bloomreach's own rankers: a delete is blocked, because they can't be recreated as they were.
notes.trained_abr_types: Trained ABR models: update_ranking_algorithm with weights turns them into ABR_MANUAL for good, so in-place weight changes are blocked; the plan makes a corrected copy instead.
notes.sensitive_signal_words: A signal whose name contains one of these (compared lower-case), or any signal with featureType CUSTOM, is a margin or cost-type signal: a change to its weight gets a warning. The script never prints any signal's min, max or other values, only names, types and weights.
notes.verify_tolerance: verify accepts a read-back weight within this much of the planned one (Discovery may store weights with different rounding).
notes.max_listed: How many pages to name when saying where an algorithm is in use.
notes.finished_statuses: Experiment statuses known not to be running, compared case-insensitively. Every other experiment, including one with no status or an unknown one (ACTIVE, PAUSED), counts as possibly running: a change to or delete of an algorithm one of its bucket rules uses is blocked, and so is one while such a test's bucket rule hasn't been read.
